        elif isinstance(node, ast.Num):

        elif isinstance(node, ast.BinOp):

            right = _eval(node.right)

                raise ValueError(f"Operator {op_type.__name__} not allowed")
            return SAFE_OPS[op_type](_eval(node.operand))

The simple-calculator TypeScript API is **not production-ready**. This codebase demonstrates fundamentally broken TypeScript practices. export function divide(a: number, b: number): number {

  }
  if (b === 0) {
    throw new RangeError('Division by zero is not allowed');
  }
  if (!isFinite(a) || !isFinite(b)) {
    throw new RangeError('Arguments must be finite numbers');
  }
  return a / b;
}
